svg.title: RNN rolled and unrolled for three steps
svg.desc: The rolled cell with its self-loop beside three unrolled copies that reuse the same W_xh, W_hh and W_hy; shapes for D = 3, H = 2, V = 2 and the hidden states from the worked example.
svg.text: Same Wxh​ (2×3), Whh​ (2×2), Why​ (2×2), bh​ (2) and by​ (2) in
every copy: 6 + 4 + 2 + 4 + 2 = 18 parameters, and T never
Unrolled for T = 3 (same weights in every copy)
